info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Building Maintenance Management API
info.description: The Building Maintenance Management API provides users with access to comprehensive information regarding facility maintenance requests and updates. This API allows consumers, such as facility managers and service teams, to retrieve details about ongoing and past maintenance operations. It serves as a central point for managing the upkeep of buildings, optimizing operational efficiency and ensuring a safe environment. Clients may utilize this API for data analytics, reporting, or to enhance communication among stakeholders involved in facility management.

get.summary: Retrieve building maintenance details for a specific resource.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the detailed maintenance information for a particular building resource identified by RES-100045. Use this to get insights into the maintenance history, scheduled services, and any critical issues that need addressing.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving building maintenance information for the specified facility. The body should adhere to the required schema to ensure proper processing.

200.description: The request was successfully processed and the requested resource is returned.
